purpose: The one test "is this type the type named X", so every Plan unit compares types the same way.
namedChanges: the body is verbatim with `typeFacetKey` replaced by `typeKey`
the registry lookup (`resolveType`, lines 71-72) is removed, as if it returned nothing; the fallback lines 73-79 are verbatim

The branches, the regex `/\/base\/t\/([^/#?]+)/i`, the `decodeURIComponent`, the `t:` strip and the empty-string case are as in the source; `typeUri(x)` (lines 83-90, `https://${baseHost()}/base/t/` + name) is written as the literal path `/base/t/` + name, with no host: the host never changes the result, because the fallback keeps only the text after the last `/`.
